title: Collect species from the coral garden
instructions: Collect two basket stars from the coral garden
Collect two coral species
Return collected specimens to the surface / designated area

title: Create a 3D image of the coral garden
instructions: Create a 3D representation of the coral garden (autonomous photogrammetry or manual/CAD)
Ensure coverage documents the extent and structure of the habitat

title: Video transect in current (coral garden)
instructions: Maintain position or fly a transect in simulated current
Record video that shows the coral garden for documentation

title: European green crab — count and report
instructions: Determine the number of invasive European green crabs in the sample
Use image recognition or manual count as allowed
Upload results to the Invasive Species form

title: Iceberg survey — measure keel depth
instructions: Survey the iceberg model
Measure and record keel depth for reporting

title: Iceberg threat assessment for platforms
instructions: Use location, heading, and keel depth of the iceberg
Determine threat level to the four oil platforms per mission rules

title: Whale-safe gear — acoustic release and pot recovery
instructions: Simulate acoustic release of retrieval buoy on whale-safe fishing gear
Recover the lobster pot per mission procedure

title: Recovery line to buoy anchor
instructions: Attach a recovery line to the buoy anchor
Return the line to the surface at the designated pool side

title: Replace eDNA sensor on Holyrood observatory
instructions: Remove the existing eDNA sensor
Install the new sensor and connect it to the Holyrood subsea observatory

title: Observatory — data frequency and camera biofouling
instructions: Analyze observatory data to determine organism sighting frequency
Remove biofouling from the observatory camera

title: Bubble curtain and micropile installation
instructions: Place a bubble curtain around the designated installation area
Install a micropile per mission specification

title: Retrieve power connector and lay cable
instructions: Retrieve the power connector from the wind farm subsea station
Lay the cable through the specified waypoint

title: Install power connector on oil platform port
instructions: Remove the cover from the oil platform port
Install the power connector securely

title: Profiling float — pre-mission build (documentation)
instructions: Prior to competition, design and construct an operational profiling float
Bring documentation photos for inspection / mission control records

title: Float — handshake before descent
instructions: Float communicates with the mission station prior to descending
Confirm mission station receives expected status or telemetry

title: Float — two vertical profiles under ice
instructions: Complete two vertical profiles under the simulated ice
Follow depth and timing constraints in the manual

title: Float — hold depth at 2.5 m and 40 cm
instructions: At prescribed stages, maintain depth at 2.5 meters
Maintain depth at 40 cm as specified for the mission scenario

title: Float — post-recovery data upload
instructions: After recovery, float communicates stored profile data to mission station
Verify data integrity at the station

title: Float — depth vs. time graph
instructions: Graph recorded data as depth over time
Submit or display per scoring / operator requirements
